title: Enum options
description: Where dropdown options come from: one watched field, or a mix of watched fields and static entries.

DynamicEntry.title: Dynamic entry
DynamicEntry.description: Options come from another field in this form (its value is watched and re-evaluated on change).

source.title: Watched field
source.description: Name of the field whose value supplies the options.

title.title: Title template
title.description: Display label for each option. Use {{item.property}} to reference fields of the current item.

value.title: Value template
value.description: Underlying value for each option. Use {{item.property}} to reference fields of the current item.

filter.title: Filter expression
filter.description: Only keep items where this template evaluates to a truthy value.

slice.title: Slice
slice.description: Take a sub-range of items, like Array.prototype.slice. One value = from index to end; two values = start and end.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort options by value. Titles follow their values.

StaticEntry.title: Static entry
StaticEntry.description: A fixed list of options. Use to mix in sentinel entries like "none" or "inherit" alongside dynamic ones.

value.title: Value
value.description: The underlying value submitted for this option.

title.title: Title
title.description: Optional display label. Defaults to the value if omitted.

oneOf.title: Single source
oneOf.description: Options come from one watched field.

oneOf.title: Multiple sources
oneOf.description: Combine watched fields and static entries into one dropdown. Each entry contributes its own options, in order.
